title: Baagi ba Ditshingwana Tse Pedi
intro: Mo lefatsheng le masego a neng a elela ka bontsi mo go lone, setšhaba sengwe se kile sa bo se itumelela ditshingwana tse pedi tse dintlentle tse dintsintsi. Matshelo a bone e ne e le bosupi jwa kamogelo ya bomodimo, le fa go ntse jalo kgang ya bone e ne ya fetoga fa tebogo e ne e fokotsega, ya felela ka phetogo e e neng e tla nna sesupo se se nnelang ruri mo go botlhe ba ba akanyang.
clues: Re ne re le batho ba ba segofaditsweng ka lefatshe la bonolo le letlotlo.
Morena wa rona o ne a re naya ditshingwana tse pedi tse dintle, tse di tlhogang e bile di na le maungo mo matlhakoreng otlhe.
Re ne re laetswe go leboga, mme re ne ra tlhopha go tlhoka tebogo mme ra fapoga.
Letamo le legolo le ne la thibela metsi a a neng a naya lefatshe la rona botshelo.
Fa re ne re ganelela mo tirong ya rona e e sa siamang, letamo le ne la thunya mme metsi a morwalela a ne a gogola.
Ditshingwana tsa rona tse di kileng tsa bo di le matlhatsa di ne tsa emisediwa ka maungo a a bogalaka, di- tamarisk le ditlhare di le mmalwa tsa lote.

trial.label: Teko/Tiragalo
options: Phefo e e bogale masigo a le supa
Pula ya matlapa go tswa kwa loaping
Morwalela o o senyang o o tswang mo letamong le le thubegang
Go goa go go kwa godimo go tswa kwa loaping
trial.answer: Morwalela o o senyang o o tswang mo letamong le le thubegang

outcome.label: Botso
options: Ditshingwana tsa rona di ne tsa emisediwa ka maungo a a botlhoko le ditlhare tse di sesane
Re meditswe ke lefatshe ka thoromo ya lefatshe
Re ne ra fetolwa go nna ditshwene le dikolobe
Re ne ra nwediwa ke morwalela o mogolo
Re sentswe ke pula ya matlapa
outcome.answer: Ditshingwana tsa rona di ne tsa emisediwa ka maungo a a botlhoko le ditlhare tse di sesane

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
